title: FLA import: embedded font symbols not converted to FontItem library entries
description: When importing a Flash 8 binary FLA, the flash8-import.ts pipeline does not create FontItem entries for embedded font symbols in the library. Font symbols appear in the binary FLA's Contents stream as type 3 (font) with a fontName and charset, plus potentially a Font N CPicPage stream with glyph data. The import pipeline skips these or silently discards them, so doc.library never contains any FontItem. Fix: in flash8-import.ts, detect font-type entries from the Contents stream (typeByte for fonts) and create FontItem entries via createFont() or equivalent. Check flash8-binary.ts for how font entries are stored in the Contents stream — look for 'font\|FontItem\|typeByte.*3\|typeFont' in flash8-binary.ts to find where font entries are read.
